sources.title: Rescoring Sequence-to-Sequence Models for Text Line Recognition with CTC-Prefixes

sources.relevance: AR drafts and selective masked diffusion refinement; reports damage to correct tokens; not OCR.

sources.title: Levenshtein OCR
sources.relevance: Image-conditioned iterative insertion/deletion and variable-length refinement in scene text recognition.

sources.title: Scene Text Recognition with Permuted Autoregressive Sequence Models
sources.relevance: Training a unified recognizer for autoregressive decoding and bidirectional refinement; not a drop-in mask change to our AR checkpoint.

sources.title: A controlled study of CTC, attention, and hybrid models for Arabic handwritten text-line recognition
sources.relevance: Controlled Arabic HTR evidence about decoder combinations and shared residual errors; different datasets and architecture.
